title: Hearing on risks posed by artificial intelligence
summary: The Council's Technology Committee is continuing its oversight hearing on the risks of artificial intelligence, with testimony expected from SpaceXAI and other interested parties after SpaceXAI failed to appear at an earlier subpoenaed hearing. The hearing examines AI's evolution from automated decision systems to generative and agentic AI, citing recent incidents of AI agents acting without authorization and ongoing debates over regulation, bias, privacy, job displacement and safety. It also reviews New York City's existing AI-related laws, including the 2018 creation of an Automated Decision Systems Task Force and a 2019 city office overseeing algorithm policy.
